(A) The handle to the scoops in the white rice cooker and a bulk rice contianer were laying in the rice.  The scoops were stored with the handles up out of the rice to correct the violation.
(B) The ladel used in the woks was stored on the side of the wok table.  It was cleaned and stored in a wok of hot water to correct.

750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) There was cardboard on a shelf above a prep table near the customer counter.  The cardboard was removed to correct the violation.
(B) The chest freezer had a build-up of frost inside it.  Defrost the freezer.
(C) There was duct tape on the hood over the woks.  The tape was removed to correct the violation.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
A moist wiping cloth was laying on the side of the wok table.  It was placed in a bucket of sanitizer to correct the violation.

750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
(A) The top inside of the microwave was soiled.  It was cleaned and sanitized to correct the violation.
(B) The round cutting boards and knives used to cut meat were soiled.  They need to be cleaned and sanitized several times a day.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:  (A) 3-compartment sink, (B) top of table where the round cutting boards are placed, (C) bulk rice containers on the metal shelf near the walk-in cooler, (D) bulk food containers on the wire shelves near the white upright freezer,  (E) big blue (garbage can size) bulk rice container near the walk-in cooler, (F) outside of the mop bucket, (G) handle to the fried rice cooker.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
One compartment of the 3-compartment sink had the drain line disconnected.  It was repaired during the inspection to correct the violation.

750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
The cover on the wastebasket in the women's bathroom is broke.  Place a covered wastebasket in the bathroom

750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
There were chips in the floor tiles under the right side of the 3-compartment sink, and around the drain in front of the sink.  Replace the tiles or fill the chipped areas with a durable, cleanable material.

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A) The doors and light switches in both bathrooms are soiled.  Clean the doors and light switches.
(B) The back exterior door and deadbolt are soiled.  Clean the door and deadbolt.
(C) The red back door, door frame, and door handle are soiled.  Clean the door, frame, and handle.
(D) The wall and light switch to the right of the back exterior door are soiled.  Clean the wall and switch.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
There was a hat and tools stored above food on the wire shelves in the back of the restaurant.  The hat and tools were removed to correct the violation.

750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(A)  Clean the floor under the table to the right of the microwave.
(B)  Clean the floor of the back room with the water heater.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
A certified Food Service Sanitation Manager was not on duty.  Have a full time food service sanitation manager on duty any time potentially hazardous food is being handled.

750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Containers of food in the Coke refrigerator prep cooler were not labeled with the date of preparation or opening.  Dates were placed on the containers.  None were more than two days old.

750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.

findings.title: Foods properly cooked and/or reheated
findings.comment:
A container of heated sweet and sour sauce was 102 degrees.   It was discarded to correct the violation.

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
(A) There were containers of food in the Coke refrigerator and prep cooler that were not covered.  There was an open bag of flour in the back of the restaurant.  Covers were placed on the containers and the flour was placed in a covered plastic bulk container.
(B) Bags of corn starch, rice, flour, etc. were on the floor in the back part of the kitchen.  Elevate the bags at least 6 inches above the floor.

750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.  750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
A plastic container was used as a scoop in a bag of flour.  The container was replaced with a scoop that had a handle.  The scoop was stored in the flour with the handle up out of the flour.

750-280 Food handlers & consumers shall avoid direct hand contact with ready to eat foods.  When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Inside the door of the white upright freezer by the door to the walk-in cooler is broken at the bottom.  Repair the broken area and do not use tape of any kind.  Use a hard material that is smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Moist wiping cloths were stored on the front edge of the wok table.  Store the cloths in the bucket of sanitizer at all times.

750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The vents in the hood above the woks and fryers were greasy.  Clean the vents so no grease drops down on the food cooking below.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
(A) the sides and front of the wok table are soiled with grease.  Clean the table.
(B) The 3 blue bulk rice containers and the bulk food containers on the wire shelf near the walk-in cooler were all soiled.  Clean the containers.(C) The spice containers on the wire shelf were soiled.  Clean the containers.
(D) The bottom inside of the upright warmer to the left of the woks was soiled.  Clean the warmer.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment clean.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The mop sink drain was stopped up.  The drain was cleared to correct the violation.

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
The dumpster lid was open.  Keep the dumpster closed.

750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The back door has a gap under it.  Seal the gap so no daylight can be seen around it.  The door must be TIGHT FITTING and SELF-CLOSING.

750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(A) The floor under the table to the right of the microwave oven is soiled.
(B) The floor of the walk-in cooler is soiled.  Clean the floor including the area under the shelving units in the cooler.
(C) The floor of the back room with the water heater is soiled.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
The cover over the fluorescent light above the 3-pan sink is missing.  Replace the light cover.

750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
There was a pile of boxes and other objects outside the back door.  Place the boxes in the dumpster.

750-1350a Food service establishments and all parts of property used in connection with their operation shall be kept free of litter.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
There was no certified Food Service Sanitation Manager (FSSM) on duty.  The restaurant's FSSM is in China.  

750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d - The toilets and urinal in both restrooms were in general soiled. Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. Clean the restrooms daily, including toilets, urinal, sinks, floors and walls.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.citation_text: 750.120 (x2) - A) Cooked shrimp & chicken were 82F-96F in cooking equipment on the back of the wok grill. Cooked foods must be held at 135F/above or properly cooled after cooking. Do not leave foods out at room temperature for any reason. Foods in question were discarded in the trash. B) Fried chicken in Coke cooler had a surface temperature of 53F. Container was in and out of the cooler at lunch time. Keep cold foods at 41F/below or use time as a control during busy lunch and dinner periods. Temperature of chicken dropped to 41F during the inspection.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - A) Can of open tomato ketchup was observed in bottom of prep cooler. Acidic foods (ketchup, pineapple, sauces, etc.) must be placed in food grade plastic or glass containers after cans are opened. Acidic foods in metal containers can cause metals/metallic flavors to leak in to foods. Obtain/use a proper plastic or glass containers. B) Chicken, carrots, sauce, and tofu were observed uncovered in the freezer by the walkin cooler, inside the walkin cooler, and in the bottom of the prep cooler. Keep foods covered between uses to protect them from potential contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Handles, faucets, & attached plumbing of the 3 compartment sink were soiled. Clean the handles, faucets, and attached plumbing of the 3 compartment sink. Also, thoroughly clean all shelves throughout, especially dry storage shelves, to eliminate potential food sources for fruit flies.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d & 1120f- A) The toilets and urinal in both restrooms were in general soiled. Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. Clean the restrooms daily, including toilets, urinal, sinks, floors and walls. B) Handles to faucet of handsink were in general soiled. Clean the handsink, faucet, and handles daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of food & general soil. Handsinks, soap dispensers, hand drying devices, and all related fixtures shall be kept clean and in good repair.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Fruit flies were observed in the following areas: A) dry storage (3-5); B) by handsink (2-3); & C) around 3 compartment sink - on walls above/below & on attached plumbing (6-10). Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Thoroughly clean in the above areas. Fly strips may be placed in areas away from food preparation/storage, single service items and equipment. Call your pest control operator (PCO) for service if cleaning alone does not get rid of the flies. Provide a copy of the receipt at the follow up inspection if PCO services the establishment.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor drain to 3 compartment sink had mold in it. Clean the 3 compartment sink floor drain and the floor under the 3 compartment sink to eliminate potential food sources for fruit flies.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Wall under 3 compartment sink was soiled. Clean the wall under the 3 compartment sink to eliminate potential food sources for fruit flies.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment: 750.1140a - Boxes of refuse containing shrimp tails, lettuce, chicken bones, & animal fat were observed outside the back door. Flies were feeding on the discarded food items. Restaurant owners discarded boxes of food waste in the trash. **Always place garbage in bags & in the dumpster to minimize presence of flies & other pests. **

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment: 750.1140c - Litter was observed along back of building & along fence behind the building. Area behind dumpsters also had litter. All litter & debris behind building & around dumpsters must be picked up/discarded properly by the next routine inspection. **keep garbage storage area clean/free of debris. **

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: 750.540a - No certified food handler on site. The only certified person is in China at this time but should return n the next month. Enough certified food handlers must be employed to cover all hours of operation and food preparation.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Over a dozen flies were observed in the kitchen, especially around 3 compartment sink. Minimize the presence of pests - fly strips may be hung in areas away from food, food preparation, and dish area (buy back door & ceiling in corner by walkin cooler). Also, keep cleaning dirty dishes as they get soiled. Do not allow dishes to pile up - dirty dishes/food debris area a food source for flies & other pests.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Outer front door had gaps where light was visible along side & bottom. Inner door was propped open. Get the outer door repaired to make it tight fitting; otherwise, inner door can not be open. Inner door was closed.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: 750.540a - No certified food handler on site. The only certified person is in China at this time but should return in the next month. Enough certified food handlers must be employed to cover all hours of operation & food preparation.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text: 750.130 - Raw foods were observed stored above & intermixed with ready to eat foods in the walkin cooler (raw chicken over container of hard boiled eggs & plastic bag of peas inside container with raw shell eggs). Also, raw shrimp was observed below/next to raw beef & pork. Store raw foods in the proper order (proper raw food storage poster provided). Store raw foods separate from/below ready to eat foods. All foods in question were rearranged and placed in proper locations to avoid potential cross contamination of products.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - A) Foods were uncovered in the walkin cooler (WIC) (various meats and egg rolls), standup freezer by WIC (meats not covered/in direct contact with frost covered shelves), & in Coke cooler (egg rolls). Also, container of flour in the corner of the dry storage area was not covered. Keep foods covered between uses to protect them from potential contamination. B) Boxes of duck and soy sauce, containers of salad oil, and a box with bottles of oyster sauce were observed on the floor in the old laundry mat side of the building. The old laundry mat area must not be used for storage of any food or single use articles because this area is not properly maintained.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text: 750.280 - Scoops in bulk food storage containers (flour, rice, etc.) were in general soiled. Some of the scoops were observed with handles to be down in the food products. Clean and sanitize the bulk food scoops daily. Store scoops in the foods with handles extended up out of the products.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Freezers were observed to have excessive frost buildup inside. Defrost and clean the freezers. B) Handle to rice scoop (stored inside cooker) had a napkin taped to it. Do not tape napkins to handle of scoop. Tape and napkins do not provide a smooth/easily cleanable surface.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Three compartment sink was full of dirty dishes and owners started washing dishes without first cleaning out the sinks and setting up the sinks for proper wash, rinse, and sanitize. Employees were instructed on proper setup of 3 compartment sink by inspector (proper 3 compartment sink setup poster was present on the wall above the sinks) and sinks were setup for proper dish washing. Always setup the sinks for proper wash, rinse, and sanitize sequence. Dirty dishes/equipment were cleaned and sanitized.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) dirty dishes/equipment piled up at the 3 compartment sink; B) inside BBQ oven; C) inside bulk food containers; & D) hood, hood filters & ansul system above wok grill. Wash, rinse, & sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) shelves throughout the entire kitchen; B) outside of bulk food containers; C) table next to 3 compartment sink; D) fryers - inside panels and sides of equipment; E) wok grill (surface was cleaned during the inspection - sides and underneath must be cleaned as well); F) mopsink; G) top of standup freezer (dirty/cluttered); H) outside of rice cookers; I) can opener holder; J) underside and legs of 3 compartment sink; & K) plumbing above drain under steam table. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Hot water was not available at the beginning of the inspection. Hot and cold running water must be available at all times. Owners indicated the hot water heater was possibly bumped and turned off during a food delivery earlier this week. Mr. Zhu turned on/repaired the water heater earlier today. After approx. 30-40 minutes hot water was available at the sinks throughout the establishment.  **Do not work on plumbing or do any repairs to the water heater or other plumbed equipment. Only a licensed State of Illinois plumber is qualified to make such repairs. For future plumbing repairs hire a licensed plumber to do the work.**

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Ceiling tile was missing in dining area, and the ventilation system was visible. Daylight was observed coming through various openings. Repairs need to be made to the ventilation system, but until the repairs are done the ceiling tile must stay in place to keep potential pests from entering through the openings in the ventilation fan on the roof. The ceiling tile was placed back up in the ceiling.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floor under steam table and prep table was soiled. Clean the floors throughout daily/as needed, especially under all equipment. B) Floor drain under steam table was not covered. Cover was observed off to the side of the drain. Place the drain cover back on the floor drain. C) Floors in old laundry mat side of building have open drains. This area is not suitable for storage of food or single use items. The laundry mat must be remodeled and meet requirements of a dry storage area or it can not be used for storage of food and single use items. Remove all food and single use items from the laundry mat.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) Some ceiling tiles in men's room were observed to have water damage. Replace the ceiling tiles that are damaged. B) Walls around 3 compartment sink and in general food prep areas were soiled. Clean the walls throughout. C) Ceiling in old laundry mat side of building had damaged ceiling tiles, exposed insulation, and a bucket was observed to have standing water in it (used to catch drip from the leaky ceiling). This area is not suitable for storage of food or single use items. The laundry mat must be remodeled and meet requirements of a dry storage area or it can not be used for storage of food and single use items. Remove all food and single use items from the laundry mat.

findings.title: Rooms and equipment - vented as required
findings.citation_text: 750.1250 - Restaurant was extremely hot. Ventilation system was not working properly. Owners said the landlord is aware of the situation and it will get fixed. All rooms must have sufficient ventilation to be kept free from excessive heat, fumes, odors, vapors, condensation, and smoke. Get the ventilation system repaired. **Fire Safety and Building Safety inspectors will be notified of issued with ventilation and areas of disrepair in the building for further investigation.**

findings.title: Complete separation from living/sleeping area, laundry
findings.citation_text: 750.1360 - Old laundry mat side of building had food items (fortune cookies, boxes of duck and soy sauce, salad oil, and oyster sauce) and a box of plastic forks stored in it. This area is also used by restaurant staff for sleeping (makeshift bed observed on top of table) and doing laundry. A complete separation of living space and food service must be established. Remove all food and single use items from the area. The laundry mat must be remodeled and meet requirements of a dry storage area or it can not be used for storage of food and single use items. If this area is for personal use (sleeping, laundry, etc.) it can not be used for storing items for the restaurant.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: 750.540a - Certified food service sanitation manager (FSSMC) was not on site during the inspection. The only person certified for the establishment was currently in China for vacation. Enough certified food handlers must be employees to cover all hours operation and food prep. Food sanitation class information was provided for owners.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.citation_text: 750.130 - Bottles & containers of food products were not labeled, including a spray bottle with water in it, a clear bottle with dark liquid in it, and a blue plastic tub with what appeared to be flour in it. Label all containers and bottles with the common name of the food product being stored, especially clear and white liquids and powders and any other products that are not easily identifiable.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750.120a - Chicken on prep table was at 54F. Chicken was removed from cold holding to make food for a customer and had not been placed back in the cooler yet. Cold foods must be held at 41F/below. After food that is going to be used for a customer has been retreived from a container the remaining product that is not in use must be put back in the cooler immediately. Do not leave potentially hazardous foods at room temperature for any amount of time. Container of chicken was placed back in the Coke cooler (holding below 41F) by the front counter.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - A) Egg rolls & chicken were not covered in the Coke cooler by the front counter. A container of meat was also uncovered in the walkin cooler. Keep foods covered between uses to protect products from potential contamination. B) Sauce pan with cabbage in it was sitting directly on top of cabbage in a plastic container. Do not place the bottoms of pans and other equipment in direct contact with food products. Place a barrier, such as plastic wrap or a lid, between the bottom of pans/other containers and the food in any containers underneath.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750.810b - Wet wiping cloth was observed on the ledge of the wok grill. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution between uses. Once rags become soiled place them in non-absorbant containers or washable laundry bags until they can be removed from the premises to be laundered.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside BBQ oven; B) shelf above three compartment sink with clean equipment on it; C) can opener blade (heavily soiled w/ food debris); & D) hood & ansul system (grease buildup). Wash, rinse, & sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to eliminate buildup of food & other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) lower shelves of prep tables; B) outside of bulk food containers; & C) dry storage shelves. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces regularly/as needed to eliminate buildup of food & other debris.

findings.title: Single service articles not re-used
findings.citation_text: 750.600 - Plastic containers labeled cashew nuts were being reused to store sesame seeds and other food items in dry storage area. Do not reuse single use items. Any containers that were purchased with food products in them can not be reused to store other food products. Obtain and use food grade, reusable containers for food storage.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.citation_text: 750.1310 - Bucket of bleach water was sitting on top of a five gallon bucket of duck sauce. Store all chemicals separate from food and equipment. Bucket of bleach water was moved to the floor next to the fryers away from the duck sauce and all other food related items.
